update.releaseNotes:
v5.9.34 - Generation farm auto-navigation
Changes --- - Generation farm now auto-navigates home → Career hub → trainee → scenario for the next breeding-plan generation instead of requiring a manual return to career selection - Restores targeted pieces of the removed cold-start navigation (team-home detection, OCR character-list pick, OCR scenario pick), scoped to mid-session run transitions only - Falls back to the prior generic click-through when no breeding-plan trainee is configured for the next run
Includes v5.9.33 generation farm release.
